conditions.workload: Fixed ceil(seconds/feed_period) rounds; delayed rounds are retained and actual duration reported

measurement.workload: Unchanged inherited fixed FE inputs/extractions and low-flow observer. Same-chunk primary geometry retained.
measurement.scope: Every input and true output retained; new whole-window probe and separate complete-cost/quiet barrier. No physical chest/peak/world-save claim.
measurement.clock: Single external Python monotonic observer for RCON and control spans. Never subtract raw nanoTime between JVMs. Probe local wall/nano anchors have1ms realtime quantization; each JVM histogram is independent.
measurement.probe: One continuous session from before initial counters through drain/quiet/final counters; fixed prefix copied by daemon after fixed counters. Every complete tickServer call in that prefix, not rolling/target TPS. Prefix endpoint is daemon copy time; crossing calls excluded.
measurement.cost: Fixed-window counter_end precedes final drain. Full lifecycle additionally includes2.2s static empty guard and final counter snapshot. SQL/WAL/local mirrors not summed as assets.
measurement.quantiles: Sparse histogram p50/p95/p99 upper-bin bounds; exact count/sum/max. Actual low-flow n and steady repeats retained.
